text:
jen: quick heads-up — prepping v2.4.0-rc1 tonight at ~21:00 PT. Need owners for: annotated+signed tag, GH draft release + assets, checksum uploads, and final changelog/migration notes. who can take what?

mike: I can do the annotated tag + push. I have my YubiKey available, will be around 20:30 PT.

sophia: changelog PR (#482) merged, release-notes.md updated with highlights and migration bullets. :white_check_mark:

carlos: artifacts: need to rotate checksums on S3 and update manifest. I can stage the checksum files but prefer to compute after CI produces the build artifacts (so after tag).

ci-bot: FYI — our release pipeline triggers on annotated tag push and will upload build artifacts to the release job if RELEASE_TAG is present. See .github/workflows/release.yml for details.

jen: @mike if you push the tag, please use the signed annotated flow and then create a draft release. snippet to use:
```bash
git tag -s -a v2.4.0-rc1 -m "v2.4.0-rc1"
git push origin v2.4.0-rc1
# then create GH draft and attach assets from local build or let CI upload
gh release create v2.4.0-rc1 --draft --notes-file ./release-notes.md
gh release upload v2.4.0-rc1 build/*.tar.gz --clobber
```

mike: question — does CI upload artifacts automatically or do I need to attach local builds?

ci-bot: release pipeline will upload artifacts when it runs on the tag if the build matrix produces artifacts. If you push a tag and CI completes, it will attach to the GH release. If you create a release before CI finishes, you can still attach later; using --clobber is fine.

sophia: added a short migration note about kv-cache layout change; one bullet in release-notes.md.

carlos: I'll compute sha256 sums from the CI artifacts and upload to s3://redwood-releases/v2.4.0-rc1/ and update the manifest.json once CI artifacts are present. Will wait for the tag push to grab the artifacts.

dana: security reminder — tags must be GPG-signed and annotated. For package registries we also need provenance attestation. Also ensure any KMS stamps on private artifacts are present before publishing.

mike: ok planning to push at ~20:35 PT from my laptop (YubiKey). Will ping here when done.

mike: pushed and draft release created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/releases/tag/v2.4.0-rc1 :rocket:

ci-bot: release pipeline triggered by tag v2.4.0-rc1 — smoke tests queued. job id: #98765

ci-bot: smoke tests completed — all checks green. summary: unit + e2e smoke ok.

carlos: downloaded artifacts from CI, computed sha256sums, uploaded checksums and manifest. s3://redwood-releases/v2.4.0-rc1/manifest.json

sophia: changelog + migration notes final, added link to manifest in release-notes.md.

jen: thanks! I'll start the canary rollout tomorrow morning. @mike can you convert the draft to a published release after the canary is green?

mike: yep — will promote after canary is verified. :thumbsup:

jen: one last note — if anyone hits publish before canary completes, pls hold off. We'll coordinate here.

mike: understood, will wait.
